pages.text: Park roughly above a $(bold)folded jack$(reset), then use it. The platform rises and checks space at the end of the animation. Success restores the wagon to blocks.$(br2)If space is blocked, the wagon remains an entity and the jack folds again. Nearby blocks, standing entities or sleepers may obstruct restoration.

Restoration preserves cargo, contents, materials and equipment states. Seated riders dismount; draft animals detach and return leads.$(br2)In block form, breaking any component cell recovers that entire part. Breaking the box or jack cascades through attached parts and cargo. Axes are effective on wooden parts.
